label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The product has a combobox with no name or label, and no selected value is announced. I could not tell what it chooses (size, color or quantity).
The login box and the guest checkout box each have a textbox called Email: with the same name. I could only tell them apart by their order in the page.
After I typed the Name and the State field appeared, focus fell onto an unnamed element and I lost my place in the form. The new State field and the removal of the shipping fields were not announced.

There are two groups of fields with the same names (billing and shipping) in the page, and the Country and State dropdowns list 249 and 61 options with no way to skip them. The list of cart links and icon links (the cart link with only an icon, social links) have no names.

In the cart, the quantity combobox has no name and an empty paragraph precedes it. The cart link in the header lost its name and item count on the cart page, and the Remove button has no mention of which product it removes.

The checkout progress list (Address, Delivery, Payment, Confirm, Complete) does not mark which step is the current one. After each Save and Continue focus was reset to the top of the page and nothing announced the new step.

findings.problem: The product has a combobox with no name or label, and no selected value is announced. I could not tell what it chooses (size, color or quantity).
